preheader: SpaceX earnings, AI cloud infrastructure rounds, and tennis updates for your evening brief.

lead.headline: SpaceX reports Q3 earnings as markets eye massive AI and data center spending
lead.body: SpaceX is reporting its third-quarter results after the bell today, marking only its second earnings report since its record IPO in June. Investors are watching closely to see how the defense tech conglomerate balances its heavy spending on Starlink and upcoming 2027 data center expansions against expected revenues.
lead.why: Understanding how massive conglomerates balance heavy capital expenditure with profitability is crucial for your finance classes and any future investing or consulting work.

stories.headline: Disney budgets $180 million for staff from bankrupt Character.AI
stories.body: Disney is spending roughly $180 million over three years to compensate and retain 66 recruits from Character.AI, deepening ties with the troubled chatbot startup after hiring its former CEO.
stories.why: This is a great real-world example of corporate development and acqui-hiring, where a legacy giant absorbs startup talent rather than building from scratch.

stories.headline: Holiday airfares surge as booking sites report steep price hikes
stories.body: Travel booking site Hopper reports that domestic round-trip fares for Thanksgiving are up 31% from last year, while Christmas tickets are 23% higher due to surging demand.
stories.why: Surging holiday travel costs show how macroeconomic inflation and consumer demand directly impact pricing power in the leisure and airline sectors.

stories.headline: Daytona raises $60 million Series B at a $1 billion valuation for its agentic cloud
stories.body: Startup Daytona has hit unicorn status after raising a $60 million funding round led by FirstMark, with backing from tech founders including Stripe's Patrick Collison. The company is building new cloud infrastructure specifically tailored to handle the heavy demands of AI agents.
stories.why: As you look at venture capital and startup trends, keep an eye on infrastructure plays that enable other software tools rather than just end-user apps.

stories.headline: Ex-OpenAI executive launches manufacturing startup Arda at a $1.5 billion valuation
stories.body: Bob McGrew, OpenAI's former research chief, has launched Arda after raising $230 million. The startup aims to use artificial intelligence to bring manufacturing back to the United States.
stories.why: Deep tech and industrial automation startups are attracting massive institutional capital, offering a glimpse into where the next wave of heavy enterprise disruption is heading.

stories.headline: Anthropic report highlights sharp drop in junior technical hiring as AI agents take over work
stories.body: An internal report from AI firm Anthropic reveals that its share of junior technical hires has fallen from 27% to 9% since December 2025 as AI agents handle more routine entry-level coding tasks. The company notes that AI working hours now outnumber employee hours six to one.
stories.why: This shift highlights why developing advanced problem-solving skills beyond basic execution will be vital for landing competitive internships in tech and consulting.

stories.headline: UC Irvine computer science professor warns about increasingly convincing fake AI images
stories.body: As courts and police grapple with deepfakes, UC Irvine distinguished professor of computer science Gene Tsudik noted that seeing is no longer believing when it comes to digital media.

stories.headline: Iga Swiatek withdraws from Ningbo Open due to thigh injury and misses WTA Finals
stories.body: Six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek pulled out of the Ningbo Open in China with a persistent thigh injury, confirming she will miss the season-ending WTA Finals in Turin.

term.name: Acqui-hiring
term.definition: Acqui-hiring is the process of buying a startup primarily to acquire its talented engineering or leadership team rather than for its products or revenue. As seen with Disney recruiting engineering talent from struggling AI startups, legacy companies often use this strategy to instantly buy hard-to-find technical expertise.

serve.headline: Daytona raised $60M at a $1 billion valuation to build the agentic cloud
serve.body: The startup secured its Series B round led by FirstMark to build infrastructure designed specifically for AI agents. The funding featured prominent backers including Stripe CEO Patrick Collison.
